rate_limits: Generally keep burst under ~5 req/s and sustained under ~9,000 req/hour; some routes may have lower limits. Exact firewall rules not published (cybersecurity).
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor right. Official FAQ (https://www.eia.gov/opendata/faqs.php#Throttles) states general guidance of ~5/sec burst and ~9,000/hour sustained, with some routes slower; exact firewall rules withheld. Original "not published" is false. example.request: auditor right. Official docs use data[0]=value in URLs (https://www.eia.gov/opendata/documentation.php), but unescaped brackets are curl glob syntax and break the command; fixed with -g/--globoff (percent-encoding data%5B0%5D also valid).
